full_name: Spanish Low Vision Quality of Life Questionnaire (Spanish translation of the LVQOL, Wolffsohn and Cochrane 2000)
domains: Far vision, mobility and lighting; Adaptation; Reading and precision work; Activities of daily life
response_scale: 0-5 (0 = can no longer perform the activity due to vision, 5 = no sight-related difficulty); N/A allowed
scoring: sum of item scores, range 0-125 (N/A items allocated the questionnaire average); higher = better quality of life
validation_method: CTT; internal consistency; test-retest; factor analysis; IRT; ROC; criterion validity
notes: Cronbach alpha 0.981 (95% CI 0.978-0.985); test-retest rho 0.864; GPCM IRT, item 16 excluded (p6); mean administration 3.0-6.6 min by subgroup (p5-6); pages 3-6

full_name: National Eye Institute Visual Function Questionnaire, 25-item version (validated Spanish version)
domains: 13 dimensions: General health, General vision, Ocular pain, Near vision, Distance vision, Vision-specific social functioning, Vision-specific mental health, Expectations for visual function, Vision-specific role functioning, Dependency due to vision, Driving, Peripheral vision, Color vision
scoring: dimension scores 0 (worst) to 100 (best); overall score also calculated
target_population: patients with visual deficit regardless of cause
notes: used as comparator for construct validity (p3, p6); facts from this paper only

domains: Mobility; Self-care; Usual activities; Pain/discomfort; Anxiety/depression; plus Visual Analogue Scale
response_scale: five levels from 'no problem' to 'extreme problems'; VAS 0-100
notes: used as comparator for construct validity (p3, p6)
